text: I see you have a longstanding pruritic rash accompanied by numbness and tingling in your palms. To understand what is causing these symptoms, have you noticed if the rash appears in specific patterns, such as along the lines of your fingerprints or between your fingers?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Not ready for final diagnosis yet.
